new_results.statement: In the r37 near-coloop original-coordinate split, for B=A[H,T] with no exact-graph assumption, sigma1(B) sigma2(B) > ((34/111)(17/288)^2) s^2. Only the third cross singular direction can vanish with graph defect.

No universal bound exists for integral ||p_(v,W)(.,w)||_2 dw even when (v,W) is an orthogonal transform of three independent cap-one coordinates. Fragmented Sidon supports give growth (4/3)2^(-3/4) sqrt(N)+O(N^-1/2).
